dialogues.speaker: Javad
dialogues.text: It does hurt pretty bad, but I'm used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Javad
dialogues.text: Even the best doctor couldn't do anything with my affliction, so I don't have any high hopes.

dialogues.speaker: Javad
dialogues.text: Compared to griping and living in fear, it's better to be upbeat and charitable.
